create_table_transformer_config: create a TableTransformerConfig instance with default settings for the microsoft/table-transformer-detection model
create_table_transformer_config_custom: create a TableTransformerConfig with custom encoder_layers, decoder_layers, and d_model parameters
create_table_transformer_config_backbone: create a TableTransformerConfig with a custom resnet backbone configuration and output stride
create_table_transformer_config_queries: create a TableTransformerConfig with a custom number of object queries for detection slots
create_table_transformer_config_loss: create a TableTransformerConfig with auxiliary_loss enabled and custom loss coefficients
